name: altinity-sql-browser
description: A self-contained, OAuth-gated SQL browser for any ClickHouse cluster. Vanilla ES modules, served from ClickHouse itself as one HTML file with all runtime dependencies bundled.

scripts.prebuild: npm run check:schemas && npm run check:examples
scripts.pretest: npm run check:schemas && npm run check:examples && npm run check:arch && npm run check:types
scripts.test: npm run build:clickhouse-http && npm run test --workspace @altinity/clickhouse-http && TZ=America/New_York vitest run --coverage --config tests/vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:watch: npm run build:clickhouse-http && TZ=America/New_York vitest --config tests/vitest.config.ts
scripts.check:types: npm run check:types --workspace @altinity/clickhouse-http && npm run build:clickhouse-http && tsc --noEmit
scripts.dev: npm run build:clickhouse-http && node build/build.mjs && python3 -m http.server -d dist 8900
scripts.local: npm run build:clickhouse-http && node build/build.mjs && python3 build/local.py
